jobs.title: Game Artist
jobs.description:
About Tamatem Games

Tamatem Games is the leading mobile games publisher in the MENA region. We localize and operate international mobile games for Arabic-speaking audiences across SLG, MMORPG, Card, and Casual genres, alongside developing our own original titles. We're two time PGC Dubai Best Publisher (2024, 2025) and Best Arabic Localization winner.

About the Role

We're looking for a versatile Game Artist who thrives across multiple games and visual surfaces. In this role, you'll produce in-game art, UI/UX, and Arabic localization assets across our portfolio, contribute to in-game promotional moments, and support our brand design work for company-level initiatives.

This is a hands-on, multi-disciplinary role for someone with strong graphic design instincts in addition to game art craft someone who can move confidently between a UI screen, a localized event banner, an in-game promotion asset, and a polished brand deck without losing quality on any of them.

You'll work closely with fellow Game Artists, Marketing Artists, and Game Developers.

What You'll Do

Game Art & UI/UX

  • Produce in-game assets across multiple titles: UI screens, menus, flows, icons, illustrations, event art, splash screens, and in-game social assets.
  • Adapt to diverse visual languages - stylized casual, anime MMORPG, medieval SLG, and traditional card-game aesthetics.
  • Validate work against tech budgets (file size, RTL integrity, accessibility, in-engine performance) and hand off cleanly.
  • Contribute to mood boards, references, and visual exploration during pre-production for new features.

Localization Art

  • Lead Arabic adaptation passes: RTL layouts, Arabic typography, culturally-adapted assets, text-in-image localization.
  • Maintain dialect and cultural-fit quality across the titles you support.

In-Game Promotion

  • Produce in-game promotional art for LiveOps events, seasonal moments (Ramadan, Eid, National Day), and feature launches.
  • Coordinate with Marketing Artists for asset reuse and visual consistency between in-game promos and marketing creatives.

Brand Design Support

  • Partner with the Brand Designer work: pitch decks, event identity, social-media brand assets, employer branding, and internal comms visuals.
  • Apply brand guidelines consistently across all touchpoints.
  • Treat brand work with the same craft bar as game art.

Quality & Collaboration

  • Hold the line on visual quality, style consistency, and craft polish across everything you ship.
  • Mentor junior team members on technique, file hygiene, and pipeline discipline.
  • Actively contribute to creative reviews and feature discussions.

What You'll Need

  • 3-5 years of experience in visual design, with at least 2 years in mobile gaming or a closely adjacent industry
  • Strong graphic design foundation - typography, layout, hierarchy, composition - in addition to game art skills
  • Mastery of Photoshop, Illustrator, and Figma; simple After Effects fluency for UI motion and light brand motion.
  • Solid understanding of UI/UX principles: screen layouts, wireframing, component libraries, interaction states, and developer handoff.
  • Strong sense of color theory, visual storytelling, and the discipline to adapt across diverse art styles (stylized, semi-realistic, anime, traditional, corporate-brand)
  • Demonstrated experience integrating AI-generated art tools into your workflow to ship faster and explore more creatively. AI fluency is required, not optional.
  • Working knowledge of Arabic typography and RTL design principles
  • Detail-oriented, self-directed, and calm under multi-track delivery pressure

Bonus Points

  • Basic 3D fluency with Blender or Maya for prop work or asset blockouts
  • Animation experience with Spine (2D) or After Effects for UI and promo motion
  • Prior experience producing pitch decks, event identity, or employer-branding assets
  • Exposure to MENA/Saudi audiences or cultural-adaptation work

Why Join Tamatem

  • Work on a diverse portfolio of mobile games reaching millions of players across MENA.
  • Join a growing creative department where craft, AI fluency, and cross-functional impact are recognized and rewarded.
  • Be part of an award-winning team shaping the future of Arabic mobile gaming.

Requirements

  • 3-5 years of experience in visual design, with at least 2 years in mobile gaming or a closely adjacent industry
  • Strong graphic design foundation - typography, layout, hierarchy, composition - in addition to game art skills
  • Mastery of Photoshop, Illustrator, and Figma; simple After Effects fluency for UI motion and light brand motion.
  • Solid understanding of UI/UX principles: screen layouts, wireframing, component libraries, interaction states, and developer handoff.
  • Strong sense of color theory, visual storytelling, and the discipline to adapt across diverse art styles (stylized, semi-realistic, anime, traditional, corporate-brand)
  • Demonstrated experience integrating AI-generated art tools into your workflow to ship faster and explore more creatively. AI fluency is required, not optional.
  • Working knowledge of Arabic typography and RTL design principles
  • Detail-oriented, self-directed, and calm under multi-track delivery pressure

jobs.title: Intern - Video Editing & Motion Graphics
jobs.description:
We are looking for a creative and talented Marketing Artist Intern to join our Creative Team. This is an exciting opportunity for someone passionate about storytelling, motion graphics, and video production to gain hands-on experience in the mobile gaming industry.

As a Marketing Artist Intern, you won't just be watching; you will be learning from senior artists and assisting on real projects. You will help create high-performance video ads and visuals that will be seen by thousands of players, directly contributing to our user acquisition campaigns.

What You Will Do

  • Create & Assist: Collaborate with Senior Marketing Artists to produce engaging video ads, motion graphics, and static visuals for social ad networks (TikTok, Instagram, Facebook etc..).
  • Innovate with AI: Experiment with the latest AI-generated art and video tools to speed up workflows and explore new creative concepts.
  • Gameplay Capture: Learn how to capture the best gameplay moments to showcase our mobile games.
  • Brainstorm: Contribute fresh ideas to creative meetings, focusing on concepts that drive user acquisition and engagement.
  • Technical Skills: Utilize industry-standard tools (Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro, Photoshop) to polish assets and bring creative briefs to life.
  • Trend Spotting: Stay up-to-date with the latest trends in gaming memes, visual design, and video marketing.

Requirements

  • Education: Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a degree in Animation, Film, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Portfolio (Required): A link to a portfolio or reel showcasing your sense of timing, motion, and design (Academic, personal, or professional projects are all welcome).
  • Software Skills: Basic to intermediate knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (specifically After Effects, Premiere Pro, and Photoshop).
  • Gaming Passion: A genuine love for mobile games and an understanding of what makes a game look fun.
  • Soft Skills: A strong willingness to learn, ability to accept creative feedback, and a collaborative attitude.

Nice to Have (Bonus)

  • Familiarity with Generative AI tools (Freepik, ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.).
  • Experience creating content for TikTok or YouTube Shorts.

jobs.title: Business Development/ Sales Executive - EMEA | Turkish Speaking Preferred
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a driven and results-oriented AdTech Sales Executive with a strong focus on UAE, KSA, and Jordan.

The ideal candidate has experience in AdTech, programmatic advertising, digital media, mobile advertising, or SaaS sales, along with a strong understanding of the regional advertising ecosystem and an established network of brands, advertisers, and media agencies.

Turkish is highly preferred due to the nature of our regional business and growth opportunities.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and lead generation to qualification, negotiation, closing, and account growth.
  • Identify and develop new business opportunities across the UAE, KSA, and Jordan.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with brands, advertisers, non-gaming apps, media agencies, and strategic partners.
  • Leverage your existing network to open new accounts and accelerate market penetration.
  • Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve revenue and business growth targets.
  • Manage and grow strategic accounts, ensuring strong client relationships and long-term partnerships.
  • Work closely with Product, Marketing, and Operations teams to align sales and go-to-market initiatives.
  • Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and customer needs to identify new opportunities.
  • Share customer and market insights to help improve our product, positioning, and sales strategy.
  • Maintain accurate sales pipelines, forecasts, and activity updates.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience in Sales, Business Development, or Account Management within AdTech, Programmatic Advertising, Digital Media, Mobile Advertising, or SaaS.
  • Experience selling advertising solutions to brands, advertisers, publishers, or media agencies.
  • Experience working with major media agencies such as GroupM, WPP, Dentsu, Publicis, or Omnicom is highly relevant.
  • Strong understanding of the digital advertising and AdTech ecosystem.
  • An established network of brands, advertisers, agencies, or publishers in the UAE, KSA, and/or Jordan.
  • Strong business development and relationship-building skills, with a proven ability to open new accounts.
